description.zh: docvi 平台通用组件包：流程、状态机、表设计、接口清单、代码走读、合并单元格表格等 24 个声明式文档视图，一切宿主通用
description.en: docvi platform general component pack: 24 declarative document views — flow, state machine, table design, endpoint list, code walkthrough, merged-cell table; host-agnostic

description.zh: 课程页页眉：课程名 + 第几步/共几步 + 学习目标，不渲染 H1
description.en: Course page header: course title + step x/y + learning goals, no H1 rendered

description.zh: 有序流程：节点 + 带标注连线，点节点可下钻
description.en: Ordered flow: nodes + labeled edges, nodes can drill down

description.zh: 教学目录树 + 每个文件/目录的职责说明，可折叠
description.en: Teaching directory tree + per file/dir responsibility notes, collapsible

description.zh: 调用链视图：谁调用了谁，可折叠
description.en: Call chain view: who calls whom, collapsible

description.zh: 分步代码讲解：行号 + 每步高亮 + 上一步/下一步
description.en: Step-by-step code reading: line numbers + per-step highlight + previous/next

description.zh: 带文件名的代码块 + 出处徽标 + 一键复制
description.en: Code block with filename + source badge + one-click copy

description.zh: 关键设计决策：决策 + 原因 + 证据（正反两种视觉）
description.en: Key design decisions: decision + reason + evidence (why/avoid visuals)

description.zh: 验收/自检清单：勾选 + 进度 + localStorage 记忆
description.en: Acceptance / self-check list: ticks + progress + localStorage memory

description.zh: 阅读收尾的下一步指引卡（多目标 + 徽标）
description.en: Closing next-step card (multiple targets + badges)

description.zh: 模块输入/输出契约与不变量（讲清谁喂什么、吐给谁）
description.en: Module input/output contract and invariants (who feeds what, to whom)

description.zh: HTTP 接口清单：默认折叠点击展开；支持非 HTTP 出口（WS/EVENT/INTERNAL）
description.en: HTTP endpoint list: collapsed by default, click to expand; supports non-HTTP exits (WS/EVENT/INTERNAL)

description.zh: 数据库表结构：一表一页签逐字段全量展开（含关系脚注）
description.en: Database table structure: one tab per table, full fields (with relation footnotes)

description.zh: 表关系概览：分层表卡 + 外键连线到字段级（悬停高亮链路）
description.en: Table relations overview: layered cards + field-level foreign-key edges (hover to highlight)

description.zh: 教学片段与真实项目快照的证据关联卡
description.en: Evidence card linking teaching snippets to real project snapshots

description.zh: 按症状/严重度筛选的故障排查表
description.en: Troubleshooting table filterable by symptom / severity

description.zh: 演进/重构 diff 视图：+/- 着色、统计、一键复制
description.en: Diff view for evolution / refactor: +/- coloring, stats, one-click copy

description.zh: 单文件 HTML 图解内嵌（sandbox iframe，零外部请求）
description.en: Single-file HTML embed (sandbox iframe, zero external requests)

description.zh: 状态流转图：分层布局 + 连线，current 状态高亮
description.en: State machine diagram: layered layout + edges, current state highlighted

description.zh: 可步进的时序图：泳道 + 单步高亮
description.en: Steppable sequence diagram: lanes + per-step highlight

description.zh: 指标卡：数值 + 变化 + 语义色
description.en: Metric cards: value + change + semantic colors

description.zh: 竖向时间轴：时间 + 标题 + 状态色
description.en: Vertical timeline: time + title + status color

description.zh: 本次改动清单：编号 + 说明 + 涉及模块徽标，可标新增/变更/移除
description.en: Change list: numbered items with summary + module badges, marked added/changed/removed

description.zh: 已知风险：严重度 + 影响 + 当前处置，区分本方案已处理 / 待独立处理
description.en: Known risks: severity + impact + current handling, marking in-scope vs deferred

description.zh: 原生 Markdown 表达不了合并单元格；用 ::: merged 容器里的 YAML 描述 rowspan/colspan
description.en: Markdown cannot express merged cells: a ::: merged container with YAML describes rowspan/colspan

description.zh: ::: merged 容器内的 YAML 描述列与单元格合并关系
description.en: YAML inside a ::: merged container describes columns and cell spans
